entities.summary: Parveen Shakir (b. 1952-11-24, Karachi) was a journalist or media commentator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Karachi and Pakistan. Known in the fields of pakistan, poets & playwrights, asia.
